units.summary: CompactStaleHead now delegates block writing and eviction to the shared compactHeadViewLocked helper, using a SelectedSeriesHead view over the stale refs. Eviction now takes an append-ID watermark, and the metrics and log lines are kept.
units.headline: CompactStaleHead now uses shared view-compaction helper with append-ID watermark
units.reason: Rewrites the stale-series compaction and eviction path, with a new watermark guard on eviction, so data-loss risk needs judging.
focus: Block meta still gets the stale-series hint on every written block
Watermark-guarded truncateStaleSeries doesn't evict series that received late samples
Behavior preserved vs the old NewStaleHead view (loop bounds, min/max time)

units.summary: inOrderBlocksMaxTime now also ignores blocks carrying the from-selected-series hint. This keeps those partial-view blocks from advancing the WAL-replay head truncation cutoff.
units.headline: inOrderBlocksMaxTime now excludes from-selected-series blocks
units.reason: It changes the WAL-replay and head-truncation cutoff, which can silently drop data if it is wrong.
focus: Hint is preserved through compaction so merged selected blocks stay excluded
Consistency with the planner's segregation of selected blocks
